app.name: Ongigil
app.tagline: A warm path, spoken aloud, for neighbours who collect recyclables
onboard.title: Welcome to Ongigil
onboard.body: We tell you, out loud, the direction and distance to recyclables nearby. You can follow by ear, without watching the screen.
onboard.privacy: No money changes hands. This is neighbours sharing information. Locations are shown only approximately, and your path is never stored.
collector.startHint: Press this big button to be guided to the nearest recyclables
collector.noSpots: No recyclables are known nearby right now. Please try again in a little while.
guide.title: Guiding
guide.screenOnNote: The screen stays on while guiding. A web app cannot reliably keep speaking once the screen turns off.
guide.markedGone: Thank you for letting us know. Let's find another.
reporter.title: Report paper
reporter.hint: Press this where the recyclables are put out. Just the location is enough.
reporter.thanksBody: You have made someone's day a little better.
reporter.privacy: The exact spot is not stored; others see only an approximate location.
helper.title: Help someone
helper.body: A family member, neighbour, or community-centre worker can report or set things up on someone's behalf.
helper.setPrefs: Set voice and text size for them
helper.howtoBody: 1) Tap 'Get guidance', then 'Start guidance'. 2) Voice tells the direction and distance. 3) On arrival, tap 'Arrived'.
settings.title: Settings
settings.mapNote: Precise street-by-street guidance turns on later when an operator adds a map key. Direction and distance guidance already works now.
settings.apiHint: Leave empty to run on this device with example data. It works with no internet and no keys.
help.title: Help
help.safetyBody: Guidance is advisory. Always watch for traffic when crossing, and never rush. Take extra care at night and early morning.
help.aboutBody: Ongigil is a free public-good service. No ads, nothing sold. Made in the spirit of neighbours helping neighbours.
help.privacyBody: Locations are shown only approximately, and your path is never tracked or stored. This service exists to support your livelihood, and always with respect.
help.credits: CLSOFTLAB (씨엘소프트랩), Dr. Lee Il-guk. Apache-2.0 open source.
common.installHint: Add this app to your home screen to open it more easily.
